```{r}
library(broom)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot01

df <- 5
x <- seq(0, df+5*sqrt(df), length=100)
y <- dchisq(x, df)
data.frame(x, y) |>
	ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
	geom_line() +
	labs(
	  caption="Simon, 2024-10-29",
	  x=" ",
	  y=" ") -> plot01

plot01
ggsave("../images/plot01.png", width=6, height=4, units="in")
```
